_comment: Canonical fxc /T ps_5_0 /O3 sha1 baselines for reconstructed deferred-pipeline PSes. Captured post-Tier-1-spec-hardening. Update with verify-shader-roundtrip.ps1 --update-baselines after a deliberate refactor.

shaders.name: bsdf_light_deferred_directional
shaders.invariant: Re-baselined 2026-05-20: corrected ambient-term multiplier from posViewLen (= 1/|posView|) to roughness01 (= 1 - matSample.x). Corpus blob 3295 / runtime sha 8c615844e644 insn 251 multiplies by r0.w which is roughness01 set at insn 35. Prior baseline 085625AF (locked at 5845b9e) had the posViewLen bug; replacing the (separately-misattributed) runtime sha caused -86% scene darkening. The DIRECTIONAL bsdf must continue to round-trip to this exact sha1; any refactor that drifts it is wrong.

shaders.name: deferred_composite
shaders._baseline_history: Re-baselined 2026-05-20: fixed matId channel (.y->.w), depth channel (.y->.x), and sunlit-color base (secondaryColor->fogColor). Tail asm now matches corpus blob 3539 insns 60-85 instruction-for-instruction; prior baseline 95D10F9E was the buggy reconstruction that black-screened in smoke.
